def siren_ringing(env): return env.siren_ringing


def switch_toggled(env): return "toggle" in env.events_this_step


def holding_box(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "box"


def box_fell(env): return "fall" in env.events_this_step


def at_exit(env): return env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]) is not None and env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]).type == "goal"
